faq.question: What is the return policy?
faq.answer: Most items can be returned within 7 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging. Damaged or defective items can be returned within 7 days regardless of use.

faq.question: How long do refunds take?
faq.answer: Approved refunds reach the original payment method in 5-7 business days. Refunds above INR 5,000 need manual approval first, which takes up to 24 hours.

faq.question: How long does delivery take?
faq.answer: Standard delivery takes 3-6 business days. Metro cities usually get orders in 2-4 days.

faq.question: Can I cancel an order?
faq.answer: Orders can be cancelled free of charge before they ship. Once shipped, you can refuse delivery or return the item after it arrives.

faq.question: How do I contact a human agent?
faq.answer: Ask the assistant to connect you to a human. Our team responds within 4 hours, 9am-9pm IST.
